WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 6)
SELECT time('now', '-' || (6 - i) || ' minutes') AS at,
       CASE abs(random() % 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'WARN ' ELSE 'INFO ' END AS level,
       'request ' || i || ' served in ' || (20 + abs(random() % 200)) || ' ms' AS message
FROM n
UNION ALL
SELECT time('now'), 'ERROR', 'upstream failed:' || char(10) || '    timeout after 30s'
